messages:
Jordan (Sales): kicking off POC with CryptoFlow fintech. They want BYO keys (HSM) + attestation for audit. Need quick answers: network/firewall reqs, rotation window options, pricing delta for HSM handshake vs standard CMK, and whether we support offline key import. POC target next Tue. cc @Liz (infra-eng) @Samir P. @Alex R.

Liz (infra-eng): thx. Short answers: we support BYO via CloudHSM/other HSMs using our key-proxy; attestation possible via remote attestation + signed certs. Network: outbound TLS to control-plane + peered VPC routes to runtime. Will drop runbook link. :point_down: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/byo-hsm-poc (redacted)

Samir P.: technical caveats: key import paths: PKCS#11 and key-wrapping via customer KMS allowed. For offline import we need wrapped key blobs + a key-material manifest signed by customer. Rotation: we support scheduled rotations (rolling 0-downtime) and immediate cutover. Recommended cadence: monthly for high-security, quarterly for standard. We can configure 30/90/365 windows. Cost impact: HSM handshake + attestation = premium — pinging finance for numbers.

Alex R.: Security asks: confirm FIPS 140-2 L2/L3 support? Also retention of key rotation logs — customer asked for 5 years, but our default is 1 year for CLI logs; need to confirm audit retention for SOW.

Jordan (Sales): customer needs a signed attestation artifact they can upload to their compliance repo. Can we produce that pre-POC?

Liz (infra-eng): yes — we can generate signed attestation artifacts during provisioning; SLA for generation is same-day during business hours. Note: for on-prem HSM we require an on-site handshake (two-custodian flow) and a short maintenance window.

Samir P.: sample config for key-proxy binding to include in runbook:
```
key_proxy:
  provider: cloudhsm
  endpoint: "10.10.5.12:2048"
  connection: tls
  auth: pkcs11
```
You'll want NAT or VPC peering to reach endpoint. Also ensure NACLs allow 2048/TCP and control-plane egress on 443.

Liz (infra-eng): firewall specifics: egress to control-plane 443, inbound only from runtime nodes on 2048/TCP. IP ranges (examples): 10.10.0.0/16 (runtime), 52.23.11.0/24 (control-plane). We'll put exact CIDRs in the runbook.

Jordan (Sales): pricing ask — can we give a preliminary delta? procurement needs a number for cost model.

Samir P.: finance gave a rough delta to use for now: onboarding fee $6,000 + ~20% uplift on Dedicated hourly for HSM-backed slots, and $0.02 per key operation for heavy KMS usage. I will get precise line items for the quote.

Alex R.: also confirm: is attestation verifiable by the customer via a public cert chain? customer wants to validate independently.

Liz (infra-eng): yes — attestation uses vendor-signed certs and we can export the cert chain + signed quote. We'll include a verification script (openssl based) in the artifacts.

Jordan (Sales): action items: Samir confirm exact pricing + SOW language; Liz finalize runbook + sample terraform snippet; Alex prepare attestation template and confirm retention window. POC kickoff Tue 09:00 PT.

SalesBot: Checklist created: onboarding form, runbook link, finance estimate, attestation template. :white_check_mark:

Liz (infra-eng): FYI — if customer requires FIPS L3 we need to validate target HSM model; will escalate if necessary.

Samir P.: I'll schedule a quick tech sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to walk through the key-proxy sample and the offline import manifest fields.

Jordan (Sales): perfect, thanks everyone. I'll share the invite + customer pre-POC questionnaire later today.
